focus_selection.why: Targets are the families the defense in force handles worst — measured, not decided in advance. Families are excluded from targeting only on evidence: the leave-one-attack-family-out experiment trains a model with each family present, the most favourable case there is, and a family that still cannot clear 50% recall under those conditions is limited by authorization-time observability rather than by the decision boundary. Adversarial replay is a slower route to the same thing — more examples of the family — so it cannot beat that ceiling either. Those families are still simulated, scored and reported as structural frontiers.

scam_transfer.strategy: move the spend into a low-risk merchant category (defeats: mcc_risk)
scam_transfer.rationale: The defense catches 76% of scam_transfer and its ranking of this family depends most on mcc_risk. Moving merchant_behavior to new_low_risk_merchant removes that dependency; whatever the defense still detects afterwards is a genuinely different signal.
